/**
 * ERPSis — Design System Industrial
 * Data: 2026-10-16
 * Revisão: R1
 * Escopo: classes reutilizáveis para campos, labels, seções e cartões de formulários industriais.
 * Regra: manter as medidas compactas; validar contraste e responsividade antes de alterar.
 */
export const cardLayout = 'bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-[2px] p-5 shadow-sm space-y-6'
export const sectionTitle = 'text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#2D8DB8] border-b border-slate-200 pb-1 mb-4 block'
export const labelClass = 'flex flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500'
export const fieldClass = 'h-8 w-full rounded-[2px] border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-800 outline-none transition-all focus:border-[#2D8DB8] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#2D8DB8]/20 disabled:bg-slate-100'

limitations: Regex scanning may miss spread props, wrapped inputs, dynamic classes and styles inherited from CSS.
A detected h-8 class does not prove rendered height is 32 px; CSS cascade and browser layout must be checked.
Widths, alignment, colors, overflow, responsive behavior and business logic require inspection of the component and rendered route.
Route-to-component mapping requires checking imports and wrappers; route counts are not counts of completed modules.
